newsitem.title: BULGARIA: SOFIA POLICE SET UP DAYTIME-ONLY MOTORCYCLE SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOFIA POLICE SET UP DAYTIME-ONLY MOTORCYCLE SQUAD.

text.p: Bulgaria has set up a rapid response squad of police motorcyclists to crack down on car theft and armed robbery -- but only during the day, Sofia police chief Emil Tanev said on Tuesday.

Tanev told a news conference the Sigma squad consisted of 100 police officers who would be equipped with Scorpion automatic rifles, bullet-proof jackets and radios. They will have 60 Czech MZ motorcycles and 10 German BMWs.

"At this stage the squad will be operating only during the day as we can not afford to risk the lives of our people at night because riding a motorcycle in Sofia's bumpy streets in the dark is very dangerous," Tanev said.
The new government which took office in May has pledged to crack down on organised crime and corruption.
